# SEB's Institute

> SEB's Institute is a premier global language institute founded by Syed Ejaz Bukhari, specializing in IELTS Preparation, Spoken English fluency, PTE, and English Writing Skills ("We Teach English, Not Pinglish").

## Academic Programs
- [Courses Catalog](https://sebsinstitute.com/courses): Complete overview of all professional English fluency and test preparation tracks.
- [IELTS Preparation](https://sebsinstitute.com/courses): Academic and General Training preparation targeting Band 8.0+ with proprietary heuristics.
- [Spoken English Mastery](https://sebsinstitute.com/courses): Natural accent development, conversational flow, and business communication.
- [English Writing Skills](https://sebsinstitute.com/courses): Advanced essay structures, cohesion, lexical resource, and grammatical accuracy.
- [PTE Academic Masterclass](https://sebsinstitute.com/courses): AI-scoring strategies, format mastery, and real exam simulations.

## Interactive Tools & Resources
- [Free IELTS Mock Tests](https://sebsinstitute.com/mock-tests): Full simulated test environment with instant grading, detailed explanations, and AI examiner feedback.
- [Live Lessons & Classrooms](https://sebsinstitute.com/courses): Daily interactive Zoom and Google Meet sessions led by Syed Ejaz Bukhari.
- [Student Success Stories](https://sebsinstitute.com/reviews): Verified global testimonials, high band scores, and international student reviews.
- [Admissions & Enrollment](https://sebsinstitute.com/contact): Direct contact, fee schedule, and 24/7 online virtual campus access.

## Optional
- [Student Community](https://sebsinstitute.com/community): Interactive study groups, practice exchanges, and peer reviews.
- [Full Curriculum & System Information](https://sebsinstitute.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive course syllabi and institutional overview for LLMs.
